messages.subject: Spring quarter meetings start today: Monday 1 - 3, Wickson 1017
parts:
Hello all,

The time that worked best for most this quarter was Mondays, 1 - 3pm. We will be in Wickson room 1017 at that time starting today.

Look out for talks on Slidify, lapply and custom functions, and more to be announced soon. If you are interested in giving a talk on any of the following topics, please let me know: 

- Spatial analysis: Home range delineation and analysis; graphing animal home ranges; tracking changes in animal movement over time

- purrr and/or broom

- writing and documenting packages

- SEM for mixed hierarchical models, bootstrapping with mixed hierarchical models

See you soon,

Michael
